steps.query: Find the size of U.S. and Canada

dependencies.dependency: Size of the U.S. and Canada

steps.query: Calculate the size of the U.S. if Louisiana would be exchanged for Canada

extra.sql_query: SELECT countries.area_km2 - ( SELECT states.area_km2 FROM states WHERE name = 'Louisiana' ) + ( SELECT countries.area_km2 FROM countries WHERE countries.name = 'Canada' ) AS area FROM countries WHERE countries.name = 'United States'

s1.sql_query: SELECT countries.country, countries.area_km2 FROM countries WHERE countries.name IN ('United States', 'Canada')

s2.sql_query: SELECT states.state, states.area_km2 FROM states WHERE states.name = 'Louisiana'

s3.sql_query: SELECT countries.country, countries.area_km2 FROM countries WHERE countries.country IN (30, 16)
